title: Create Examination
description: Configure examination mode, choose blueprint patterns, bind question pools, and set AI proctoring.
exam_published_body: {title} is live for its window. Only assigned candidates can see it.
no_shareable_link: There is no shareable link, by design. An assigned candidate signs in and finds the exam under My Exams, which is what keeps a paper from being opened by whoever has the URL.
choose_pattern_title_corporate: Choose a Corporate Hiring Exam Pattern
choose_pattern_desc: Select a structured blueprint to pre-configure sections, rules, timers, and question pool filters.
early_questions_title: Already know the questions? Write them now
early_questions_desc: Type the question, its options, and tick the correct answer. Saved to your Question Bank and added to this exam's pool at step 5.
answers_note: Correct answers stay on the server. Nothing here is ever sent to a candidate's browser.
step3_desc: Configure titles, window duration, subject binding, and mode-specific parameters.
field_instructions_hint: Shown to the candidate before they start.
placeholder_description: Short overview of syllabus, topics covered, and evaluation structure...
placeholder_instructions: e.g. No calculators. Answer all questions. Read each question carefully...
field_difficulty_hint: A descriptive tag shown to candidates.
field_questions_per_candidate_hint: Calculated from the section rules — never typed, so it cannot contradict them.
step4_desc: Define the sections and algorithmic rules to draw random questions from your pool.
placeholder_section_duration: Leave blank for shared exam timer
section_chosen_desc: {chosen} chosen of {needed} this section draws. The rest are drawn at random from the shared pool.
step5_desc: Write questions yourself, reuse the bank, generate a set with AI, or import a file. Use as many of the four as you like.
pool_save_draft_first: The pool belongs to an exam, so the exam has to exist before questions can join it. Go back a step and save the draft.
guided_mode_label: Guided: one section at a time, filtered to exactly its subject, type and difficulty.
advanced_mode_label: Advanced: write, browse, AI-generate or import freely into the shared pool.
guided_incomplete: Every section still needs its exact question count selected before you can continue.
step6_desc: Only assigned candidates ever see this exam. Assigning somebody whose login access is still pending is allowed — the exam waits for them.
step7_randomisation_desc: The pool holds {total} questions. Each candidate sits {per_candidate} of them, drawn by the section rules.
toggle_randomize_body: Every candidate gets the same questions in a different order — the count never changes, and a question never leaves its section.
toggle_shuffle_options_body: A separate setting. Shuffles A/B/C/D within each choice question, so "the answer is C" is not shareable. Off by default.
randomise_off_warning: With randomisation off, every candidate sits the pool in the order you arranged it — so the pool must hold exactly what you want asked.
step7_proctoring_desc: These settings decide what gets detected and flagged. They never decide whether a candidate cheated — you rule on the evidence afterwards.
toggle_webcam_body: Continuous facial presence, plus multiple-face detection.
toggle_gaze_body: Raises a signal on prolonged off-screen looking.
toggle_fullscreen_body: Tab switches and window blur are recorded with timestamps.
toggle_copy_paste_body: Clipboard actions inside the runner are refused.
toggle_microphone_body: Checked during the pre-flight test, before the timer starts.
toggle_single_display_body: A second monitor is refused at pre-flight.
field_max_focus_violations: Times a candidate may leave the exam
field_max_focus_violations_hint: Tab switch, minimise, or leaving fullscreen. On the last one their answers are submitted and the exam closes. 0 turns this off.
field_max_tab_switches_hint: Earlier switches warn the candidate; this many flags the sitting.
field_flag_score_hint: The sitting is marked for your review at this score.
field_terminate_score: Suspicion score that ends the sitting
field_terminate_score_hint: Must be above the flag score. Ending a sitting is not a verdict.
publishing_blocked_no_pool: Build the question pool first — an exam with no questions cannot be sat.
review_paper_first: Open the "Question Paper Preview" tab above and check the exam exactly as it will appear to candidates before publishing.
publish_once_published: Once published and a candidate has started, the question assignment can no longer change.
none_candidates_note: Nobody is assigned yet, so nobody will see this exam. You can assign them after publishing.
checklist_window_valid: Exam window is valid and fits the duration
checklist_one_section: At least one section with rules
checklist_enough_questions: Enough questions in the pool for every rule
checklist_answer_keys: Every pooled question has an answer key or model answer
checklist_no_duplicates: No duplicate questions in the pool
checklist_section_match: Every selected question matches its section's subject, type and difficulty
checklist_paper_reviewed_detail: Open the "Question Paper Preview" tab above before publishing.
checklist_proctor_detail: The score that ends a sitting must be above the one that flags it.
checklist_no_answer_key_detail: Some pooled questions have nothing to grade against.
toast_draft_saved_with_pool: Draft saved — now build the question pool
toast_early_questions_added: {count} question(s) you wrote earlier added to the pool
toast_stray_questions: {count} question(s) are for another subject — they stayed in the bank.
toast_could_not_add_early: Could not add your earlier questions.
toast_save_before_picking: Save the draft before picking questions for this section.
